logic.entry: At the first OOS 00:01 UTC one-minute open, enter long once and hold regardless of subsequent signals.
logic.exit: Scheduled terminal exit at the end of the common OOS interval.
logic.sizing: Independent unlevered long-only spot reference with 2000 USDT initial capital; same exchange filters, lot/notional, costs, and terminal cost as candidates.
logic.signal_timing: Fixed OOS start/end; historical closes are not used for a signal.
